boundary.zh: WPS 365 统一 OpenAPI 产品面（Kingsoft Office Open APIs v7）：通讯录/组织、云文档（drive/documents/sheets/dbsheet/airsheet）、消息（im）、会议、日历、智能文档（aidocs/aippt/airpage）、邮件、待办、审批（workflow）、wiki、事件订阅等。官方机器契约为 open.wps.cn 发布、经官方 MIT CLI 分发且字节可复现的 OpenAPI 3.0.0 规范（806 paths / 827 operations / 3,119 schemas）。事件订阅采用加密 HTTP callback（AES-CBC + HMAC-SHA256 签名）；15 个 `/v7/sse/*` 端点使用 text/event-stream；其余为纯 REST（GET/POST/DELETE，无 PUT/PATCH）。认证为 OAuth2 app（client credentials）与 delegated（用户授权）双通道，另有可选 KSO-1 HMAC-SHA256 请求签名。
boundary.en: The supplier-defined WPS 365 unified OpenAPI product surface (Kingsoft Office Open APIs v7): contacts/organization, cloud documents (drive/documents/sheets/dbsheet/airsheet), messaging (im), meetings, calendars, smart documents (aidocs/aippt/airpage), mail, todo, approval workflows, wiki, and event subscriptions. The official machine contract is an OpenAPI 3.0.0 specification published on open.wps.cn, distributed through the official MIT CLI and byte-reproducible (806 paths / 827 operations / 3,119 schemas). Event subscriptions use encrypted HTTP callbacks (AES-CBC + HMAC-SHA256 signature); 15 `/v7/sse/*` endpoints use text/event-stream; the rest are plain REST (GET/POST/DELETE, no PUT/PATCH). Authentication is OAuth2 dual-channel app (client credentials) and delegated (user authorization), with optional KSO-1 HMAC-SHA256 request signing.
